plate_comment: Returns the channel's fueling (is_engine_speed 0) or engine speed severity index after one ramp step: plus the ramp rate (capped at 0x100) while the over-limit duration is past the derate start duration, else minus it (floored at 0) (was threshold_adjustment_ramp)

1 when the channel's input is past the threshold picked by is_engine_speed and threshold_select (the minimum / maximum or lower limit pointer, the shutdown duration threshold, the shutdown severity threshold), compared below or above by configuration flag 0x4; a switch input (configuration flags 0x30) tests its masked bit instead (was protection_threshold_check)

Sets the channel's restart severity indexes: with configuration flag 0x1 the fueling one is 0 while the input is inside its threshold, else 0x100 (flag 0x40) or the input interpolated between the minimum and maximum thresholds; with flag 0x2 the engine speed one is 0 or 0x100 (was protection_threshold_update)

Channel 4 only (this build has channel 0 alone; the e2m names the restart limitation after oil pressure): once engine_protection_shutdown_count_cal reaches the limit and the channel's errors are allowed, raises the restart limitation shutdown approaching flag while the fueling duration runs, takes an override request (clears the duration, starts the override lamp), and commands the shutdown once the duration passes the shutdown warning time (was protection_state_transition)

Counts the channel's fueling (is_engine_speed 0) or engine speed shutdown time up by one (saturating at 0xFFFF); in the engine start pass it also sets the matching start warning time to the configuration's shutdown delay (was protection_event_timestamp)

With the engine protection shutdown and restart enabled and a shutdown channel recorded, updates that channel's restart severity indexes and checks its restart limitation while its shutdown and restart enables are set (bits 130 + 4n / 131 + 4n of the algorithm enable flags); every other channel's restart indexes are 0 (was governor_fault_derateCalc_channelIter)

Per channel, while its errors are allowed: counts the fueling duration (configuration flags 0x101) and the engine speed duration (0x402) up by one while the input is past its threshold (saturating), 0 otherwise; both are 0 while the errors are not allowed (was governor_fault_eventCounter_update)

Per channel: arms the errors-allowed timer (the start monitor engine speed and time), then, while the errors are allowed, treats a fueling / engine speed fault as active when the precrank error, the severity index or the shutdown time count says so, counts its elapsed time and opens its fault log entry, or closes the entry (was governor_fault_channelProcess_mainLoop)

For the current channel's fueling (0) or engine speed (1) fault: opens the log entry at the history's log index the first time (occurrence time = key_on_hour_meter, extreme value 0x8000 / 0x7fff, duration 0), sets the fault's detected bit, tracks the extreme value, and copies the entry into the channel state (was fault_snapshot_capture)

For the current channel's fueling (0) or engine speed (1) fault: once the fault's active bit is set, clears the detected and active bits and, if an entry is open, writes its duration (key_on_hour_meter - occurrence time), copies it into the channel state and advances the log index % 5 (was fault_event_timing_snapshot)

Initializes the engine protection module: points the fuel temperature channel's state at its input (fuel_temperature_sensor_filtered), thresholds and fault logs, resets the fault derate limits, the start sequence, the protection mode state and the sensor channel data, and sets engine_protection_task_index to 0 (it is not a sensor channel initializer) (was hpcr_initFuelTemperatureSensorChannel)
